entities.summary: Ernst Wilhelm Bohle was the Gauleiter of the Foreign Organization of the National Socialist German Workers' Party from 1934 until 1945. Bohle was the only defendant in the Subsequent Nuremberg trials of 1946-1949 to plead guilty to any charge.
